title: Here’s Where to Find Tickets to Celine Dion’s 2026 Paris Residency Online
summary: The residency marks the singer's first shows since announcing her diagnosis with Stiff Person Syndrome in 2022.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Queen Celine is back.

Celine Dion made a triumphant return to the stage this month as the singer kicked off her 26-date Paris residency at the Plenitude Arena in Nanterre on Sept. 12. Dion delighted a joyous, sold out crowd with a setlist of both French and English-language songs comprising some of her biggest hits, along with personal favorites.

The Paris residency marks the “I’m Alive” singer’s first run of shows since announcing her diagnosis with Stiff Person Syndrome in 2022, which ultimately led to her cancelling a North American and European tour. Now on the road to recovery, Dion is staying in one place as fans flock to Paris to catch the diva on stage.

Tickets to Dion’s Paris shows were initially released through Ticketmaster in April, though most dates are now almost sold out. You can check the Ticketmaster France website to find resale tickets or to see if new seats have been released (which sometimes happens closer to show date).

FIND CELINE DION TICKETS ON TICKETMASTER

There are other ways to find tickets to Dion’s remaining dates, through third-party retailers that have a large inventory of seats available. Many of them have promotional offers that get you a discount on tickets too.

EDITOR'S CHOICE

StubHub

$131+

FIND TICKETS ONLINE

Start your search for Celine Dion tickets online at StubHub, which has surprisingly affordable seats from just $131 (as of this writing).

The ticket marketplace lets you search for Dion tickets by price, view, zones (i.e. first few rows of a section) and perks, like VIP access or packages with food and drink included.

StubHub’s FanProtect Guarantee ensures valid tickets delivered in time for your concert, or your money back. If your show is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund.

BEST DEALS

Vivid Seats

$170

Vivid Seats has tickets to Celine Dion’s Paris residency from just $170 , with all-in pricing, meaning there are no hidden fees or additional charges at checkout.

Buying multiple seats or looking for group tickets? Vivid Seats has a rewards program that gives you your eleventh ticket free (in the form of a site credit) after you purchase ten tickets online. See more details at VividSeats.com .

LOWEST PRICES

TicketNetwork

$128+

While Ticketmaster is the official ticketing provider for Dion’s residency, the cheapest ticket prices we’re seeing online is through TicketNetwork , a resale marketplace.

TicketNetwork has cheap seats from just $128 to see Celine Dion in Paris, with the ability to search by section and row through the site’s interactive seating map. TicketNetwork says “prices may be above or below face value,” depending on the seller, and we’ve often found good deals on the site closer to showtime.

Use our promo code  BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to take $300 off purchases of $1,000 and up at TicketNetwork.com .

All three sites guarantee authentic tickets or your money back, and offer fast delivery of tickets by phone or email (i.e. no need to meet up to exchange stubs).

Celine Dion is seen outside her Hotel on September 03, 2026 in Paris, France.

GC Images

Dion is staying at the Le Royal Monceau – Raffles Paris while in town, holding court at the iconic luxury property near the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées. The French-Canadian singer has been seen posing for photos and interacting with fans who have been lining the street in front of the hotel each day in the hopes of catching a glimpse of the star. Le Royal Monceau has also played host to everyone from Michael Jackson to Madonna over the years.

As for the residency, while the concerts are being billed as Dion’s big return to the stage, the singer did perform at the 2024 Paris Olympics , where she delivered a soaring rendition of Édith Piaf’s “Hymne A L’Amour” from atop the Eiffel Tower.
